description: Human-reviewed highest validated upstream agent version per hook connector x OS. The live connector E2E workflow (.github/workflows/connector-live-e2e.yml) only REPORTS the version it ran against and opens a connector-regression issue on a live-cell failure — it never edits this file. A maintainer updates last_validated_version here (and, when raising/lowering a support floor/ceiling, hook_contracts.json + internal/gateway/connector/hook_contract.go) after reviewing a green run. 'os' keys are linux, macos, windows; an empty last_validated_version means 'not yet certified'.

cursor.notes: Cursor Agent CLI and Cursor Desktop have distinct version schemes. A current upstream version is not validated support; macOS remains uncertified until durable packaged and authenticated official-client evidence is recorded.

opencode.notes: OpenCode 1.16.2 remains the compatible floor; 1.18.10 is the latest source-reviewed release and 1.18.11 is the exclusive review ceiling. Native Windows remains preview-only. No OS is certified until a durable latest-version packaged and authenticated official-client run is green and reviewed.

copilot.notes: Native Windows implementation is present but not certified; official-client Windows evidence remains pending.

openhands.notes: OpenHands CLI 1.16.0 is the current upstream release and supports macOS. Standalone OpenHands SDK 1.39.1 is separately source-reviewed and does not change the CLI compatibility range. Native macOS status is UNCERTIFIED pending a durable green latest-version live run.

hermes.notes: All 23 v0.19 shell-hook-valid events are mapped by official role. A genuine-client macOS driver is available for durable hosted validation, but packaged plus official-client macOS and Windows certification remains pending.

windsurf.notes: contract-only (Layer A); Devin Desktop is a GUI with no headless Cascade driver. Latest stable 3.6.22 compatibility is source-reviewed, but macOS and Windows certification remain empty until a durable genuine packaged interactive live run exists.

antigravity.notes: Native macOS and Windows implementations and deterministic contract checks are present, but certification remains pending durable latest-version packaged and authenticated official-client evidence. The macOS connector lab and Windows manual cell reuse operating-system keyring/browser authentication; neither auto-stamps this inventory.

omnigent.notes: contract-only on macOS and Windows; the 0.7.0 contract is current, but neither platform has a reviewed durable latest-version live certification record; native Windows remains degraded preview
